--- select_interval_string_single.sql
SELECT
  INTERVAL '1' DAY AS day_value,
  INTERVAL '-2' MONTH AS month_value,
  INTERVAL '1.5' SECOND AS second_value,
  INTERVAL 1 DAY AS integer_value,
  INTERVAL @days DAY AS parameter_value,
  INTERVAL '1-2' YEAR TO MONTH AS range_value

--- AST

  Query: &ast.Select{
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.Alias{
        Expr: &ast.IntervalLiteralSingle{

--- SQL
SELECT INTERVAL "1" DAY AS day_value, INTERVAL "-2" MONTH AS month_value, INTERVAL "1.5" SECOND AS second_value, INTERVAL 1 DAY AS integer_value, INTERVAL @days DAY AS parameter_value, INTERVAL "1-2" YEAR TO MONTH AS range_value
